data.content_ref: inline:The claim that separation is unnecessary via 'Persona-Induced Divergence' (SRC_004) contradicts the 'Blind Spot Correlation' mechanism (SRC_005) by asserting that activation patterns (software state) can override weight-distribution biases (hardware state). This relation is refuted if the 'critic' persona consistently fails to identify hallucinations that are high-probability paths in the model's latent space, regardless of the prompt's adversarial intensity.
